title: Lever integration for interview scheduling
description: Keep Lever as your system of record while Cadence schedules interviews: candidate sync in, outcome write-back out, encrypted credential connection.

faq.q: Can Cadence connect to Lever and Greenhouse at the same time?
faq.a: Yes. Connections are per-provider, so a workspace migrating between ATS platforms can run both, with each candidate linked to the provider they came from.

faq.q: What happens to Lever data when a candidate is erased?
faq.a: A GDPR erasure in Cadence purges the candidate's personal fields including the ATS-linked ones Cadence holds, and the audit trail keeps only internal identifiers.
